The '''Wayfar Cantina''' was a popular establishment in the small [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
[[File:Wayfar_cantina_interior.jpg|left|thumb|Inside the smoke-filled cantina.]]
The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was the largest building and the center of the small [[City/Legends|town]]. It had two entrances, one in the front and one in the back. The cantina consisted of a large room with a long, U-shaped bar counter in the middle of the room where a bartender sold beverages. Six large booths along the walls provided tables and chairs where people could sit down, drink and listen to the music. A door behind the bar led to a small back room that wasn't in use as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. In another room in the back of the cantina, several [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machines were installed, including [[Lugjack/Legends|Lugjack]] and [[Jubilee Wheel (game)|Jubilee Wheel]].

Among the beverages available at the bar were [[Bantha Blood Fizz]], [[Ardees/Legends|Ardees]], [[Tatooine Sunburn]], [[Lopez Softdrink]], [[Milk/Legends|milk]] and imported [[Utozz]].

==History==
[[File:Wayfar_cantina_back_room.jpg|thumb|The back room.]]
At least one [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] worked in this cantina. Among the beings who visited this cantina regularly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] were [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Yondalla]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Stanic Wavingstar]] and [[Walda]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] recruited by one of the minions of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], rescued Stanic Wavingstar, one of Jabba's informants, from a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] assassin in front of the cantina.<ref name="SWG:TI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Troublesome Influences|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This cantina is a location in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The developers used the building model that was also used for most other cantinas in the game. Like all cantinas in the game, it features a bartender that sells a small selection of drinks as well as various [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPCs) of random gender, appearance and profession. There are also three NPCs that offer small quests or are involved in other quests.

The cantina also provides a place for players of the [[:w:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer profession]] to perform their music and dancing acts and give out buffs.
